aggregation: Sum positive per-test weights after trustworthy complete execution. Parameter cases share a fixed scientific-family budget within each domain; adding cases does not increase its budget.
hard_gates: Exact authenticated collection and complete setup/call/teardown for every node.
No candidate crash, RPC deadline, broken protocol, interrupted verification or incomplete session.

At least one new policy result must have its complete public schema checked, or report infeasibility confirmed by independent enumeration. Existing deterministic dispatch and adapter checks alone do not deliver the requested policy interface.

Initial obligations, transition ramps and leaf carry state determine whether the schedule can be operated.
Storage inherits actual parent energy and obeys losses, exclusive operating modes and terminal reserve.
Active topology, island gauges and DC power transfers must remain valid across electrical scales.
A feasible dispatch must attain the stated optimum in original cost and physical units.
True infeasibility must be distinguished from numerical failure and feasible schedules.
Native state, existing dispatch, ordering invariance and the supported tree size must remain usable.
Inclusive bounds and topology-dependent rounding budgets define the promised numerical support.
Malformed adapters and unsupported tree attributes must be rejected by the declared interface.
